validation_method: Every lot car with a WMI used by a rule, a 17-character VIN and a valid check digit is classified. The model year comes from VIN character 10 (the listing year only picks the 30-year cycle and must be within 2 years). A rule fires only when the VIN matches its WMI, years and fixed characters and the code is in its table for that year; other codes get no claim. Ground truth = scraper/manual_detect/ground_truth.jsonl. Lines with uniformCell set are treated as unlabelled (counted separately as uniform_cell_lines_excluded / _that_would_agree), speeds-only lines are excluded, and the rest are checkable: agree means (truth is manual) == (rule says manual). Note that every VIN-bearing truth line comes from vPIC, which NHTSA builds from the same Part 565 filings, so agreement is partly circular. The EPA cross-check (year/make/model union, vPIC displacement when known) is the independent check: a manual claim is consistent when EPA lists a manual for the car, an automatic claim when EPA lists a non-manual. Status: candidate (not counted) when the evidence is short of the bar; drop when >= 20 checkable and agreement < 0.995; low_sample when < 20 checkable (kept: the code meaning comes from the manufacturer's own VIN scheme); keep otherwise. newly_confirmed_manual counts lot cars with no published transmission (vehicle_extras trans empty) that a keep or low_sample rule calls manual.

verification.kind: adversarial re-check by a second session (task: refute rules)
method: Re-downloaded the cited MID filings from vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov/mid/home/displayfile/<guid> into a fresh directory and read the VIN tables (page images for scanned files, text layer otherwise). Each rule's verified.checks names the filings re-read; a few early Subaru scans (MY1986, 1989, 1991, 1997, 1999, 2009 Forester, 2012, 2014) were not re-read and rest on the first session's reading plus vPIC agreement.

Re-read Wikipedia (raw wikitext: Mazda RX-8, Mazdaspeed3, Mazda6, Mazda Familia, Isuzu MU) for every quoted sentence; ran web searches for second text sources (RX-8 2004 launch, MAZDASPEED Protege, 1998 Amigo, Solterra WMI).
Re-checked every EPA row id quoted against scraper/manual_detect/epa/vehicles.csv, and listed all EPA rows for each scope to look for an automatic in a manual-only cell.

Counterexample search: (a) ground_truth.jsonl and published lot labels (built in, see validation); (b) the whole vPIC decode cache, lots and history (rule verified.vpic_cache_scan); (c) for Subaru, vPIC trims that are automatic-only or manual-only against character 11; (d) vPIC decodes of pattern VINs at scope edges (2012-2013 Mazdaspeed3, 2004/2005 RX-8, unfiled Mazdaspeed6 GG14L, 2001-2002 BJ227, 1991 Stealth, 1991-1998 Isuzu Rodeo/Amigo).

Scope edges checked: model-year boundaries against the years each filing defines a code; WMI/plant (Solterra JTM, SIA-built Isuzu/Honda/Toyota, JAC vs 4S2); body/line codes shared with automatic models (Amigo vs Rodeo, Mazda5/CX-7 'L', 2001 BJ227); Canada-market cars (Mazdaspeed3, RX-8 are the same as US).
